auth.personalAccess: Personal access to your PEA portfolio.

appError.title: This page could not be displayed.
appError.description: A new version of the app may be available, or the connection to the server was interrupted.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.subtitle: Visual reading of each portfolio line's weight.

valuation.trailingPEHint: Price divided by trailing 12-month earnings for the whole portfolio (value-weighted harmonic mean). Loss-making holdings are excluded.
valuation.dividendYieldHint: Annual dividend divided by price, weighted by each holding. A stock paying no dividend counts as 0%.
valuation.betaHint: Portfolio sensitivity to the market: 1 = moves with the market, above = more volatile. For an ETF, 3-year beta against its index.
valuation.exclusionNote: Holdings without data are excluded from each average; the covered share is shown under each metric.

lookThrough.highlight: Through your ETFs, you hold {{via}} of {{name}}.
lookThrough.highlightWithDirect: Through your ETFs, you hold an extra {{via}} of {{name}}, {{total}} in total.
lookThrough.undisclosed: {{weight}} of the portfolio is not detailed: Yahoo only publishes the top 10 holdings of each ETF.

dividends.payoutRatioHint: Share of earnings paid as dividends. Up to 60%: comfortable; above 90% or with a loss: fragile.
dividends.fcfCoverageHint: Free cash flow divided by dividends paid (latest fiscal year viewed on the asset page). Below 1, the dividend is not funded by cash flow.

capitalization.title: Market cap
capitalization.hint: Large caps above EUR 10bn, mid caps from EUR 2bn to 10bn, small caps below. ETFs form a separate bucket.
capitalization.currencyHint: Currency the holding trades in. For an ETF, it may differ from the currency of the securities it holds.

correlation.none: No highly correlated pair (above {{threshold}}): your holdings move independently.
correlation.hint: Correlation coefficient of daily moves over one year: 1 = both holdings move together, 0 = no link, -1 = opposite. Two highly correlated holdings add little diversification.

admin.title: Server administration
admin.subtitle: Users, Yahoo Finance diagnostics, tracked markets, and maintenance actions.

users.title: User management
users.standardRoleHelp: New accounts are always created with the standard user role. The admin role is reserved for the bootstrap account created during initial setup.
users.deleteDescription: This action will delete the {{username}} account and its associated data. The bootstrap administrator account and your current session are protected server-side.

actionsPanel.title: Quick actions
actionsPanel.rebuild1dInfo: Deletes and rebuilds only the 1D intraday data for tracked assets.
actionsPanel.rebuild1dConfirm: This action will delete and rebuild 1D market data for all tracked assets. Continue?
actionsPanel.rebuild1wInfo: Deletes and rebuilds only 1W candles according to the configured interval.
actionsPanel.rebuild1wConfirm: This action will delete and rebuild 1W market data for all tracked assets. Continue?
actionsPanel.rebuild1mInfo: Deletes and rebuilds only 1M candles according to the configured interval.
actionsPanel.rebuild1mConfirm: This action will delete and rebuild 1M market data for all tracked assets. Continue?
actionsPanel.rebuildAllInfo: Deletes and rebuilds the complete daily history used for YTD, 1Y, 5Y, 10Y, and ALL.
actionsPanel.rebuildAllConfirm: This action will delete and rebuild ALL market data for all tracked assets. Continue?
actionsPanel.rebuildAllRangesInfo: Deletes and rebuilds all market ranges: 1D, 1W, 1M, and ALL.
actionsPanel.rebuildAllRangesConfirm: This action will delete and rebuild all market data for all tracked assets. Continue?
actionsPanel.refreshAnnexInfo: Clears all non-chart caches and downloads snapshots, financials, dividends, news, profiles, analyst consensus, and calendar events again.
actionsPanel.refreshAnnexConfirm: This action will clear all caches except charts and download all annex data again for all tracked assets. Continue?
actionsPanel.cleanupUnlinkedInfo: Deletes data for explored stocks and ETFs that are neither in the portfolio nor in the watchlist.
actionsPanel.cleanupUnlinkedConfirm: This action will delete data for explored assets that are linked neither to a transaction nor to the watchlist. Tracked and portfolio assets will be kept. Continue?

markets.title: Tracked markets
markets.deleteDescription: This action removes {{market}} from tracked markets and cleans its scheduler history. It will be rejected if assets are linked to this exchange again.
markets.deleteMarketTitle: Delete this exchange from tracked markets

yahooUsage.title: Yahoo Finance usage
yahooUsage.noFeature: No call in the last 24 h

features.title: Yahoo features
features.help: Each feature adds Yahoo Finance calls. When disabled, it makes no call at all and its block disappears from asset pages. Measure its cost in the Yahoo usage section before enabling it.

keys.extended_fundamentalsHelp: Balance sheet, cash flow, analyst trend and quarterly results (2 calls per asset per week).
keys.quarterly_statementsHelp: Quarterly balance sheet and cash flow, loaded only when a user asks for them.
keys.insightsHelp: Short, mid and long-term outlook and relative valuation (1 call per asset per day).
keys.similar_assetsHelp: Suggestions of related assets on the asset page (1 call per asset per week).
keys.markets_pageHelp: Indices, currencies and commodities (1 quote batch per minute, only while the page is open).

news.title: News
news.emptyAsset: No article linked to this stock yet.

searchPage.title: Search
searchPage.subtitle: Search for stocks or ETFs and add them to your watchlist.
searchPage.noLocalResult: No result in the local PEA list.

avatar.help: Drag to reposition - mouse wheel or slider to zoom

dividends.aristocratHint: Dividend per share raised at least {{count}} years in a row (currently {{streak}}), complete calendar years.
